title.cn: 颐和园：皇家空调外景地

text.cn: 昆明湖风大到说话要喊。租船要扫码——皇帝当年大概不用验证码。长廊里游客像潮汐，导游旗是灯塔。
text.en: Kunming Lake wind forces shouting. Boat rental wants QR — emperors never needed SMS codes. The Long Corridor is tidal with tourists; guide flags are lighthouses.

text.cn: 租船慢划：把一天交给湖面与胳膊酸痛。
text.en: Rent a boat: donate the day to water and sore arms.

feedback.cn: 你划得像一条犹豫的鸭子，但 Sanity 明显回升。皇家园林：治疗系。
feedback.en: You paddle like an indecisive duck, but sanity rises. Imperial gardens: healing type.

text.cn: 漫步长廊 + 爬佛香阁：台阶再次背叛承诺。
text.en: Corridor + tower climb: stairs betray again.

feedback.cn: 俯瞰昆明湖很美。你的膝盖提交了辞职信，尚未获批。
feedback.en: The lake view is beautiful. Your knees submit a resignation — pending approval.

text.cn: 高峰硬挤：被导游旗驱赶的羊群体验。
text.en: Peak crush: herded-sheep experience under tour flags.

feedback.cn: 你看见了佛香阁的屋顶一角。其余时间在看别人的后脑勺。
feedback.en: You glimpse a corner of the tower roof. The rest of the day: other people’s haircuts.

text.cn: 颐和园日结束。风还在，队伍也还在。
text.en: Summer Palace day ends. Wind remains; so do queues.
